method: tools.mjs verify: each quote matched against the cached text of its own source after normalising Unicode compatibility forms, quotes, dashes, whitespace and PDF line-break hyphenation; "…" joins fragments that must occur in order. Word limits per quote (50) and per source (editorial policy), counting the dataset’s existing quotes from the same source expression. Merge problems (structure, roles, earliest located, loaded words in statements and qualifications outside quotation marks) are listed separately.
